questions.explanation: Pydantic was created by Samuel Colvin to make parsing and validating external data with Python types practical. In v2, `BaseModel` defines the schema and `Field` adds constraints; treat `ValidationError` as an expected input failure. Type hints alone do not validate at runtime, and Pydantic does not replace authorization or business rules.
